label: Circulation and flux of curl
subgoals: See Green's theorem as the flat case

visual.title: A flat surface is Green's theorem
visual.caption: A vortex has circulation at every radius. Seen as a surface integral, the same number is the flux of the curl through the disk, which is the flat case of Stokes.

predict.question: Stokes' theorem becomes Green's theorem when:
options: The surface is flat and lies in a plane
The boundary shrinks to a point
predict.explain: On a planar surface the flux of the curl through it is the double integral of the scalar curl, which is exactly Green's theorem.
